Battery Smart · BaaS & Swap · Ride-time overlays

Hear the ride-time overlays

Tap a state to play it the way a rider would get it: the card drops in over the map with its sound, then a Hindi voice line while the logo pulses. High-severity alerts get a short urgent pulse; everything else gets a gentle chime. Sound is on. Check your volume first.

Idle. Pick a state.

Tap the card to replay the voice. Tap its button to dismiss.

What you're hearing

  • Two sounds, by severity. High severity (battery 5%, battery issue, Swap low charge) gets a short urgent pulse: two quick double-beeps, the second pair a step higher, 0.6 s. Everything else (payments, not charging) gets a gentle two-note chime. Both are placeholders for a sound designer.
  • The voice goes straight to the message. No brand opener: the logo on the card and the pulsing ring show where it came from. Lines are 4–6 s, amounts are spoken as words, and the copy follows the Hindi glossary (पेमेंट लेट है, लेट फीस लगेगी).
  • Voice: Swara, a Hindi female neural voice (Microsoft, hi-IN), used as a stand-in. For production, record the final lines with the ElevenLabs "Devi" voice or a voice artist, and keep the file names.
  • No vibration is shown. On a real phone, high-severity alerts should vibrate in the same rhythm as the urgent pulse.
